description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a trigger button.
overview:
`DropdownMenu` opens `DropdownMenuContent` next to a `DropdownMenuTrigger` when it is pressed. The content renders through a portal (inside a full-window overlay on iOS) as a raised, rounded card positioned below the trigger by default.

Items can be plain actions, checkbox items, radio items in a group, or a submenu. `DropdownMenuSubContent` expands in place under its trigger, and the caret turns to point down while it is open. For a menu that opens on long press at the touch point, use Context Menu.
usage:
Use `render` on `DropdownMenuTrigger` to render it as a `Button`. Items close the menu when pressed unless `closeOnPress={false}`.

Use `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` with `checked` and `onCheckedChange`, and `DropdownMenuRadioItem` inside a `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` with `value` and `onValueChange`. Group items with `DropdownMenuGroup` and `DropdownMenuLabel`, and divide sections with `DropdownMenuSeparator`.

Set `variant="destructive"` on an item that deletes or removes. Use `inset` on items without an icon to align them with items that have one. Position the content with `side`, `align`, `sideOffset` and `alignOffset`.

examples.Checkboxes: Checkbox items that toggle panels on and off.
examples.RadioGroup: Radio items that pick one value.

parts.DropdownMenu: Root that holds the open state.
parts.DropdownMenuPortal: Portal the content is rendered into.
parts.DropdownMenuCheckboxItem: Row with a check mark that toggles.
parts.DropdownMenuRadioGroup: Group of radio items with one value.
parts.DropdownMenuRadioItem: Row that selects one value in its group.

DropdownMenu.onOpenChange: Called when the menu opens or closes.

DropdownMenuContent.side: Side of the trigger to open on. Defaults to `bottom`.
DropdownMenuContent.align: Alignment against the trigger. Defaults to `start`.
DropdownMenuContent.sideOffset: Gap from the trigger. Defaults to `4`.
DropdownMenuContent.portalHost: Name of the portal host to render into.

DropdownMenuItem.inset: Adds start padding to align with icon items.
DropdownMenuItem.closeOnPress: Closes the menu on press. Defaults to `true`.
DropdownMenuItem.disabled: Dims the item and blocks presses.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.onCheckedChange: Called with the new checked value.

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.iconClassName: Extra classes for the caret icon.

accessibility:
- The trigger has the `button` role.
- The popup has the `menu` role; items use `menuitem`, `checkbox` and `radio` roles, and radio groups use `radiogroup`.
- Groups are labelled by their `DropdownMenuLabel`, and separators have the `separator` role.
notes:
- Uses `bg-surface-raised`, `bg-item-pressed`, `bg-item-selected` and `bg-danger-surface-pressed` tokens; light and dark follow the system appearance.
- The fade-in respects the system Reduce Motion setting.
